title: Jimmy Kimmel Mocks the President’s ‘Pettysburg Address’
summary: “And where better to reassure the public that they are in good hands than in front of a pool you’ve repeatedly botched to the tune of $16 million?” Kimmel said of Trump’s speech before the midterms.
